name: LP-EM-CC2755P10 LaunchPad development kit
sources: CC2755x10 data sheet SWRS306E (September 2026; core, memory, radio, currents, 3.85 CoreMark per MHz); TI product and tool pages for CC2755P10 and LP-EM-CC2755P10; SimpleLink Low Power F3 SDK 9.21.00.36 board file LP_EM_CC2755P10.syscfg.json and Board.html (pins, LEDs, buttons, flash chip, chip CC2755P105E0WRHAR); all read 2026-10-07. No public board user guide on that date

columns.head: The chip: CC2755P10
items: Processor: Arm Cortex-M33
Runs the program at up to 96 MHz, with a floating-point unit
Flash: 1,024 kB
Holds the program and the radio stacks. Kept when the power is off
RAM: 162 kB
Working memory. 4.5 times the CC2340R5's 36 kB, enough for a Thread router
Radio: 2.4 GHz, up to +20 dBm
Bluetooth 6.0, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, private packets. 143 mA at +20 dBm

columns.head: Connections inside the chip
items: GPIO: up to 31
On/off pins for LEDs, buttons and control lines
UART: 2 / SPI: 2 / I2C: 1
Serial text, fast bus for displays and flash, two-wire bus for sensors
ADC: 12-bit, 1.2 Msps
Measures a voltage. Eight outside inputs, plus temperature and battery
APU and HSM
Math unit for vectors and Channel Sounding; security unit for AES, ECC, SHA-2

columns.head: On the board, and missing
items: On the board
Red and green LEDs (DIO16, DIO12), two buttons (DIO20, DIO0), 1 MB SPI flash
Antenna
Printed antenna, plus a U.FL socket for an outside one
Not on the board
No USB port and no probe: it needs the LP-XDS110ET for power and flashing
Watch out
LED jumpers must be closed for the LEDs (TI's SDK board notes)
